campaignRules: Never treat a download button, free reading access, or a waqf statement by itself as a blanket republication license.
Every acquired file must carry source URL, rights evidence, retrieval timestamp, SHA-256, and edition metadata.
Protected books are registered now so they are not forgotten; their full text is not published until permission is documented.
When a rights holder grants permission, update the same record and promote it to redistributable mode without changing the bibliographic identity.
Where only online reading is granted, enable the in-app reader and citation workflow while keeping download/export disabled.
For translations, each language/edition is tracked independently because translation rights can differ from the Arabic original.
The final downloadable encyclopedia bundle contains only works whose redistribution status is verified.
